text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you're a Trainer too, right?
In that case, won't you...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Scout me right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being pleaded with at point-blank range...
Staring into those sparkling eyes,
I found myself—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Don't do it!! Snap out of it, it's a trap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I snapped back to my senses.
I'd almost been totally wrapped
around the little marshmallow girl's
finger...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So close! Just a tiny bit more!
And here I thought I finally found the
one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She'd mentioned smelling something sweet
earlier...
Was she picking up the scent of the dessert
I had after lunch?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What I found is a sweet, pushover Trainer
I can have tons of fun hanging out with♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about teaming up with me?
It'll be super easy for you too, y'know?
'Cause I can win without even trying anything
special♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm super amazing,
after all. Mock races are a total breeze
even when I'm just coasting. Sooo—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just sign that contract already☆
Come on, it'll be great♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Her raw talent was glaringly obvious from
her run.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't just accept a contract without
knowing who she really was.
Not until I knew if she had what it takes
to succeed as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Talk...? Okey-dokey,
got it! Let's chat it up! ☆
See ya this Sunday, then! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to just sit down and talk in
the Trainer's office right away...
And so—the following Sunday arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! A-muse-ment paaaark! ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's ride that one,
the crazy screamer coaster!
Put your hands up! ☆
Let's scream "Aaaaaaaah!!" together!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, before that, we need to ta...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Bgyaaaaaaah! *Gag*, ohhh goddd~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*Urp*... Bad... I'm so grossed out...
Trainer, somewhere to rest...
choice_data_list: Feeling sick? Let's head to a bench...
Feeling sick? Let's head to a bench...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~, that looks super hard, no way...
I want something way fluffier...
choice_data_list: I wonder if there is one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She begged to ride it herself,
only to end up like this.
Later,
on the way back from the amusement park...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
is that a new spring arrival?!
I'm gonna try it on! ☆
It's totally gonna look so good on me and
super cute! ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you wear that one over there,
Trainer!
Then we can do matching coords! ♪
choice_data_list: Huh...? You want me to wear someth...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's fine,
it's fine! I bet it'll totally suit you~.
Let's post it on Umastagram!
Pretty please...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She pushes her own preferences on others
without a second thought.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*Ack*, whew~~!
This pink mapo tofu is way spicier than I
thought!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, swap with that almond jelly! ♡
Oh, and toss in that iced tea too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without waiting for my answer,
she swiftly swapped the mapo tofu with the
almond jelly.
It seemed like she lacked common sense,
but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh~? Am I really that free-spirited~?
I always act like this when I go to amusement
parks with Mom and Dad, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
On the way home,
the three of us try on clothes~,
and we order a buuunch of sweets together
and they let me eat whatever I want~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My friends are pretty much the same way!
If I just go "Pretty please!",
they'll do anything for me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I finally understood what kind of horsegirl
Fusaichi Pandora was.
This girl was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl raised with utter,
complete indulgence...
She undoubtedly had raw potential, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That talent was buried deep in a swamp of
pure sugar...
If I tried to dig it up carelessly,
I'd end up getting swallowed whole
instead.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
We've talked plenty now, right?
We spent the whole day together!
So that means—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Contract time,
contract time!
♪ Let's make it official already! ☆
Don't we need a stamp or something?
Go ahead and press it right there! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt myself almost getting dragged into
the Pandora swamp.
Yet, despite her pushiness,
the reason I couldn't write her off was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That running form... It was breathtaking.
Getting her to take racing seriously might
be an impossible feat. Even so—
choice_data_list: A girl with this much raw talent i...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving such talent buried would be an utter
waste.
If so, the only compromise was...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, not yet~? Stamp it, stamp it! ♪
choice_data_list: I can't... stamp it just yet...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Why not?
choice_data_list: Before we can sign a contract—I ha...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? A condition...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was the best resistance I could muster
against this pampered little imp.
